jobs.title: Ads Growth & Insights Data Analyst
jobs.content: About Us BEES, a subsidiary of AB InBev (ABI), has revolutionized the global beer route to market by creating a digital B2B marketplace application that directly connects retailers with manufacturers and distributors, simplifying processes such as ordering, scheduling deliveries, and obtaining support. Originally launched in 2019 for ABI, BEES now encompasses relationships with 1st party partners (where ABI sells and distributes) as well as 3rd party CPG companies—such as Nestle, Mondelez, L’Oréal, and Gloria—offering them a Digital Transformation service to digitize their route to market. As of 2024, BEES operates as a multicategory application in 26 countries and continues to expand, with over 3.5 million registered customers, including retailers, bars, restaurants, hotels, grocery stores, and pharmacies, managing over $40 billion in global GMV annually. Role Overview As a Data Analyst
